game_concept: A speed quiz set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake, a lake of glacier melt: the summit pilot must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Cipher Decoder: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake: a lake of glacier melt
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Lake, repeat each round: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes. Each round, a new supply crates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the decoded value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 600 points of supply crates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Cipher Decoder
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Cipher Decoder' (Week 8 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Glacier Lake'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how decoded changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Lake.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 600 within 46 seconds.
